title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot Agent Mode creates executive summary slides
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and the documented licence-assignment control. Its feature-specific gaps remain unconfirmed by Microsoft documentation; the checklist's abbreviated licence path needs a small clarification.

claims.claim: Agent Mode in PowerPoint can generate an Executive Summary slide for a presentation.
claims.quote: Generate an Executive Summary slide for your presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Copilot in PowerPoint for the web requires third-party cookies to be enabled.
claims.quote: For Copilot to work in Word for the web, Excel for the web, and PowerPoint for the web, third-party cookies must be enabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses is the user licence-assignment path.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign, then select Save changes.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and empty RemoveLicenses assigns a licence through Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center licence-assignment guidance requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The checklist gives Users > Active users > Licenses and Apps as the route to checking a user's licences.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section
claims.fix: Replace the checklist path with 'Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses', matching the table and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/assign-licenses-to-users.

claims.claim: Licence assignment controls a user's licensed Copilot experience rather than configuring executive summary slides separately.
claims.quote: Chat experiences in Microsoft 365 apps vary depending on your tenant configuration and license.

claims.claim: The Copilot settings page names no PowerPoint, Agent Mode or executive-summary setting, and no separate switch for this feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Agent Mode" admin disable settings Graph; PowerPoint executive summary slides Agent Mode disable admin policy Microsoft Graph prerequisites rollout. Read configure-copilot-admin-center in full; no named PowerPoint, Agent Mode or executive-summary setting.

claims.claim: The Graph PowerShell licence-assignment route accepts User.ReadWrite.All or another permission in the Assign license reference.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.

claims.claim: LicenseAssignment.ReadWrite.All is the least-privileged Graph permission for assigning licences.
claims.quote: Permission type | Least privileged permissions | Higher privileged permissions; Delegated (work or school account) | LicenseAssignment.ReadWrite.All; Application | LicenseAssignment.ReadWrite.All
